mentions.name: Nox Engine
mentions.description: A diffusion inference engine offering a Python API to control diffusion model inference (image and video), built as an alternative to node editors like ComfyUI. The initial Python/PyTorch version was too slow, so all inference was rewritten in C++/CUDA, approaching hardware limits on tested devices. Benchmarks are in progress, with planned high-resolution comparisons (1536x1536 for images, 1344x768 for video) to show scaling.
mentions.problem: Node editors like ComfyUI lacked a decent Python API for controlling diffusion inference, and Python/PyTorch implementations were too slow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a diffusion inference engine. I dislike node editors like ComfyUI and wanted a decent python API to control it. The first version was another python/PyTorch variant which was decent but still way too slow to my liking.

I ended up rewriting all the inference in C++/CUDA and I'm finally getting close to limits on the devices I tested.
mentions.author: Spectrallic
